info.title: Software Factory API
info.summary: Versioned HTTP surface for runs, work items, factories, scoring, benchmarks, self-improvement, secrets, integrations and webhooks.
info.description:
Every public resource route lives under `/api/v1`. Breaking changes bump the prefix and the old version keeps serving until it is removed deliberately. `GET /health` stays unversioned for probes.

**Servers.** The canonical document declares the direct API origin, `http://localhost:8080` — use it from Swagger UI, Postman or a script. The console serves the same document at `/api/openapi.json`, and `/api/openapi.json?servers=console` rewrites `servers` to the console origin (`/`): the browser then calls `/api/v1/…` same-origin and the console proxies those requests server-side, so the API host never appears in the browser and CORS never applies.

**Authentication.** Accounts and opaque sessions (change `add-console-auth`). `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets the HttpOnly `factory_session` cookie; only a SHA-256 hash of the token is stored, so a database leak does not hand out live sessions. With `AUTH_REQUIRED=1` (compose) every route except `/health`, `/auth/login` and `/openapi.json` needs a session and answers `401 auth_required` otherwise. Roles: `admin` manages users and sees all work, `member` sees only the rows they created. With `AUTH_REQUIRED=0` (tests, local development) the API runs as the implicit local user and no cookie is needed.

This document is the source of truth: `apps/api/test/openapi.test.ts` fails when the served routes and this spec diverge.

get.description: Identity probe for the optional websocket-capable proxy (`compose.proxy.yaml`). Caddy's `forward_auth` calls it before reverse-proxying to the local forge: a `200` carries `X-WebAuth-User: <username>`, which Caddy copies onto the proxied request so Forgejo auto-logs-in the signed-in console user; `401 auth_required` stops the request when nobody is signed in. 409.description: invalid_state — the mission is terminal or not in a controllable state.

post.description: Records the next status and a `mission.resumed` event, then Signals `missionResume`. A paused mission with an undecided plan gate resumes into `awaiting_plan_approval`; otherwise `running`. A non-paused mission is `409 invalid_state` (a running mission returns `alreadyRunning: true`).

parameters.description: Stable factory id (`fac_<ulid>`). A member resolves only factories they own; any other id is 404.

post.description: Cooperative and idempotent: records the cancellation request once, appends exactly one `mission.cancelled` event, sets `cancelled`, then Signals `missionCancel`. A terminal mission is `409 invalid_state`.

post.description: Resets a failed, skipped, pending or ready feature to `pending` (attempt incremented) and appends a `mission.feature.retried` event. MVP does not Signal the workflow: the scheduler picks the pending feature up on its next pass. Running and done features are `409 invalid_state`.

400.description: invalid_request — malformed body, query or path.

404.description: mission_not_found / mission_feature_not_found.

409.description: invalid_state — the feature is running or done.

details.description: Optional structured context (ids, limits, offending field).

RunArtifact.description: One artifact recorded on a run. `storageKey`/`bucket`/`contentType` are additive (ADR-047): rows written before the artifact store have only `path`/`bytes`/`sha256`/`kind`, and consumers must keep working with both shapes.

path.description: Path relative to the run directory.

storageKey.description: Object-store key when the blob lives in the artifact store.

bucket.description: Bucket holding the object; present with `storageKey`.

contentType.description: MIME type recorded at upload time.

GateDecisionVerdict.description: Parsed agent verdict that produced an automatic gate decision (change `add-agent-verdicts`). `source` says whether it came from the fenced JSON block, the textual fallback, or nowhere. Null for human gates and for gates decided before migration 015.

summary.description: The block's own summary (or the matched textual signal).

findings.description: Optional findings emitted with the verdict.

GateDecision.description: One durable stage gate decision. `verdict` is additive and may be absent on older rows.

User.description: A console user. The password hash is never returned.

username.description: Slug used for the forge identity and the personal org `u-<username>`.

MissionPlan.description: A mission plan (`v1alpha1`): validation contract with behavioral assertions plus milestones and features. Validated by `validateMissionPlan`.

Mission.description: A durable mission above work items: goal, pinned definition version, plan, status, budget and cancellation request.

MissionSummary.description: A mission row plus the progress counts and attributed spend used by the list projection.

exceeded.description: Stable reason when a mission cap is reached, else null.

cookieAuth.name: factory_session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, 7-day expiry). Send it as a cookie; the value is never accepted in a header or query.

bearerAuth.description: Per-host agent token returned once by `POST /api/v1/runner-agent/enroll`. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored; deleting the host revokes it.
